general-dentistry.name: General Dentistry
general-dentistry.description: Comprehensive dental care for routine check-ups, diagnosis and everyday oral health.

root-canal-treatment.name: Root Canal Treatment
root-canal-treatment.description: Relieving pain and saving infected teeth through careful root canal therapy.

smile-designing.description: A personalised plan to enhance the appearance of your smile.

flap-surgery.description: Surgical treatment for advanced gum disease, to protect teeth and supporting bone.

laser-dentistry.name: Laser Dentistry
laser-dentistry.description: Modern laser-assisted treatment for greater precision and patient comfort.

pediatric-dentistry.name: Pediatric Dentistry
pediatric-dentistry.description: Gentle, friendly dental care designed for young patients.

full-mouth-rehabilitation.name: Full Mouth Rehabilitation
full-mouth-rehabilitation.description: Comprehensive restoration of all teeth for patients with extensive dental wear or damage.

complete-dentures.description: Full removable dentures to replace all missing teeth and restore function.

teeth-bleaching.description: Safe professional whitening treatment to brighten your smile.
